snippet.title: Michael Jackson Shorts
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson (1958-2009), known as the “King of Pop,” was one of the most influential musicians in history. Starting as the lead singer of the Jackson 5, he gained fame with hits like “I Want You Back.” His solo career took off with Off the Wall (1979) and reached its peak with Thriller (1982), the best-selling album of all time, featuring classics like “Billie Jean” and “Beat It.”

Jackson’s music videos, innovative performances, and signature dance moves, like the moonwalk, revolutionized pop culture. Despite facing personal controversies, his impact on music, dance, and fashion remains unparalleled. He passed away in 2009, but his legacy endures.

Jackson died on June 25, 2009, from acute propofol intoxication, shocking the world. Despite his troubled personal life, his legacy as one of the greatest entertainers endures, and his music continues to inspire generations.
